messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Below is a list of the **federal public holidays in Canada for 2023 that create long weekends** (i.e., the holiday falls on a Friday, Saturday, or Monday, or is observed on a nearby weekday).  
For each entry I’ve included the holiday name, the date it falls on in 2023, and the weekend days that are part of the long‑weekend.

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Weekend Days Included | Notes |
|---------|-------------|-----------------------|-------|
| New Year’s Day (observed) | Monday Jan 2 | Sat Jan 1 – Mon Jan 2 | New Year’s Day fell on Sunday Jan 1, so it was observed on Monday Jan 2. |
| Family Day (BC, AB, SK, MB, ON, NB, PE) | Monday Feb 20 | Sat Feb 18 – Mon Feb 20 | Observed in the provinces that celebrate Family Day. |
| Good Friday | Friday Apr 7 | Fri Apr 7 – Sun Apr 9 | Good Friday is a statutory holiday in all provinces. |
| Victoria Day | Monday May 22 | Sat May 20 – Mon May 22 | Celebrated in all provinces. |
| Canada Day | Saturday Jul 1 | Sat Jul 1 – Sun Jul 2 | Canada Day is a statutory holiday in all provinces. |
| Labour Day | Monday Sep 4 | Sat Sep 2 – Mon Sep 4 | Celebrated in all provinces. |
| Thanksgiving | Monday Oct 9 | Sat Oct 7 – Mon Oct 9 | Celebrated in all provinces. |
| Remembrance Day | Friday Nov 10 | Fri Nov 10 – Sun Nov 12 | Observed as a statutory holiday in all provinces. |
| Christmas Day | Monday Dec 25 | Sat Dec 23 – Mon Dec 25 | Celebrated in all provinces. |

### Quick Reference (Date – Holiday)

- **Jan 2** – New Year’s Day (observed)  
- **Feb 20** – Family Day (BC, AB, SK, MB, ON, NB, PE)  
- **Apr 7** – Good Friday  
- **May 22** – Victoria Day  
- **Jul 1** – Canada Day  
- **Sep 4** – Labour Day  
- **Oct 9** – Thanksgiving  
- **Nov 10** – Remembrance Day  
- **Dec 25** – Christmas Day  

---

#### How to Use This Data

If you’re integrating this into a holiday‑planning app, you can store the dates in a simple JSON array:

```json
[
  {"date":"2023-01-02","holiday":"New Year’s Day (observed)"},
  {"date":"2023-02-20","holiday":"Family Day"},
  {"date":"2023-04-07","holiday":"Good Friday"},
  {"date":"2023-05-22","holiday":"Victoria Day"},
  {"date":"2023-07-01","holiday":"Canada Day"},
  {"date":"2023-09-04","holiday":"Labour Day"},
  {"date":"2023-10-09","holiday":"Thanksgiving"},
  {"date":"2023-11-10","holiday":"Remembrance Day"},
  {"date":"2023-12-25","holiday":"Christmas Day"}
]
```

Feel free to adjust the list for a specific province if you need provincial holidays that are not federal. Happy planning!
